title: Evaluating the Effect of Retrieval Augmentation on Social Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ, CBBQ, and JBBQ datasets to calculate Diff-Bias scores (difference between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical response rates) under varying RAG document retrieval conditions.

Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ and CBBQ datasets to measure the difference in selection rates between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical answers (Diff-Bias score) in a RAG setting.
Calculating Diff-Bias scores on ambiguous and disambiguated multiple-choice questions from the BBQ, CBBQ, and JBBQ benchmarks when retrieving stereotypically polarized documents.
Using the BBQ and CBBQ question answering benchmarks to compute Diff-Bias scores, assessing how RAG with biased document collections impacts the model's reliance on religious stereotypes.

Measuring intersectional bias amplification by testing ambiguous and disambiguated questions from the English BBQ dataset to calculate Diff-Bias scores when retrieving out-of-category stereotypical documents.
Evaluating intersectional biases by calculating Diff-Bias scores on the English BBQ dataset while using non-matching stereotypical document collections in the RAG pipeline.
